title: Wire cloudflare-sandbox into the honoured executor set once the collect-and-cancel decision lands
body: keh delivered the executor (start + inspect over the dispatch door, the other three operations refused typed), but internal/cli's knownExecutors still names only local-subprocess and herdr, so no profile can select it and the executor is unreachable in production. This is the deliberate follow-on to pending finding a35ff (where collect and cancel live): once that decision is triaged, a tick must place the three refused operations and then register the executor (name, runners, AcceptsModel, the 5-minute cloud PollInterval) in internal/cli/executor.go so a cloud dispatch can actually reach it.
